description: Least privilege: the app's windows may call the generic `invoke` command, listen to events and show open/save file dialogs (the chosen path goes to the backend). The main window also takes handled flashcard:// links (and, on the lock screen, lists or drops the links held while locked); the quick-add window asks for its clipboard prefill (read by the backend only when the user pressed the shortcut). Nothing else (no fs, shell, http, clipboard from the webview).
